protocol.initialization: Frozen train empirical whole-road initializer, once per seed; both arms restore the exact fleet and post-initialization PCG64 state
protocol.rng: One uniform per actor per maneuver in frozen vehicle order; same-seed common-prefix uniforms must be byte-identical across arms
protocol.cav_collision_reporting: not applicable: this is the all-natural NDE, not the separately conditioned IDM-CAV D2RL experiment
protocol.reference_scope: Same train exposure and 10 Hz marginal bins as frozen NDE; new seeds are independent Monte Carlo replications, not a new highD test set
protocol.bin_rule: Center bins with half-step edges and two explicit tails, identical in source and both arms; no adaptive binning or pseudocounts
protocol.joint_state_distance: Hellinger on fixed gap x relative-speed bins
protocol.mae: Mean absolute difference of normalized bin probability masses; not trajectory position/speed MAE
protocol.interaction: Leader/front first, follower/rear second; quantized effective forward 1 s accelerations, quiet stable leader/lane for both actors during previous 3 s and next 1 s, same as frozen interval reference selector
protocol.persistent_scope: Report strict 60 s common-pair counts. If source has no such tracks, those fidelity distances are unavailable; separately report 5 s windows with identical pair IDs persisting in both arms and source windows with the same duration/domain rule
protocol.censoring: Retain all 100 seeds including failures. Primary paired exposure uses each seed's common pre-terminal duration; separately report all available exposure and full-60s common survivors. Time tables report reached cohorts and common survivor counts

bootstrap.reference: fixed empirical highD reference; CI excludes source-data uncertainty

protocol.decision: Report paired delta and percentile CI. Require reductions in rr and joint-state H plus no detected speed/gap degradation. Non-significance alone does not establish noninferiority; no numeric noninferiority margin was supplied

persistent.strict_60s_reason: No 60 s observed highD tracks in the fixed source; no synthetic ground truth substitution.
persistent.quiet_rule: Both highD actors have abs(yVelocity)<0.2 m/s throughout; both simulated actors have no active lane change throughout. Same pair/lane identity and supported gap/speeds at every physical/source frame, including endpoint.
persistent.scope: Outcome-conditioned common-pair subset; histograms and probability MAE, not ground-truth trajectory MAE.

limitations: Single is the frozen highD method-aligned independent adaptation, not exact paper reproduction.
Both arms retain V34 explicit LC feasibility restrictions, same empirical initialization and direct dynamics.
Reference is previously used train data; bootstrap covers Monte Carlo seeds conditional on this reference, not highD uncertainty.
Primary exposure is paired to the earlier collision. Late-time/fixed-completion/persistent cohorts are conditioned on survival.
No 60 s source persistent pairs or matched future real trajectories; no trajectory MAE is invented.
Collision contacts have positive rectangle overlap; these are reported contacts, not an independent claim of a nonphysical artifact.
No inference about D2RL efficiency or numerical comparisons against published paper scores.
